detail: Full summary: A store finalized by migrate --to 3 refuses every registry write from the same build with FORMAT_VERSION_TOO_NEW (lead-reproduced on a one-record store at 0f9fd985); only identity-init stores accept writes, so the upgrade path yields a store the product cannot write to
